title: Got a !!warning!! Today!
body:
I started this following along with this project back in January and got my own rayhunter set up in February. I drive A LOT for work so it stays with me in the truck. Well this morning I walked out to a warning message for the first time ever. 

I pulled the .pcap file in wireshark and didn’t see an event that corresponded with the date and time on the web gui. I found two red ERROR events that are nowhere close to the date and time the warning appeared. 

So… what do I do now ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
